messages:
Priya: looping back on yesterday's postmortem  we have a recurring midnight memory pressure event on the rerank pool. Need clear owners, JIRA links, and a RACI so this actually ships.
Daniel: I'll volunteer to own the immediate mitigation (eviction tuning + guardrails). Can someone take the long-term investigation?
Rosa: I can take the deep-dive (heap profiles, GC patterns, kernel change diff). Prefer to split: short-term mitigation ticket + investigation ticket.
eng-oncall-bot: Incident logged: INC-2026-0401-02  Memory pressure on rerank. Auto-triage: paging to SRE. Logs: https://logs.redwood/INC-2026-0401-02
Tomas: Noted. I'll coordinate with capacity team for a temporary scale-up if mitigation rollout causes instability.
Priya: Ok RACI proposal here: Responsible=Daniel (mitigation), Responsible=Rosa (investigation), Accountable=Priya (drive closure), Consulted=Tomas + infra, Informed=customer-success + oncall.
Daniel: Creating tickets now: REDW-9123 (mitigation: eviction thresholds + soft OOM guard), REDW-9124 (investigation: heap/stack analysis + kernel diff). Links: https://jira.redwood/browse/REDW-9123 https://jira.redwood/browse/REDW-9124
Rosa: I accepted REDW-9124. ETA: initial findings in 5 business days, full RCA in 12. Will attach flamegraphs and a reproducible stress test.
Daniel: I'll prototype eviction tweak and a canary flag in 48 hours. Proposed acceptance criteria: no soft-OOMs on 6h soak test at 1.2x peak traffic, and alert suppression for non-actionable noise.
Priya: Add an explicit rollback plan in the ticket: revert flag, scale-down, and post-rollout verification steps. Also link postmortem doc to the tickets.
Tomas: I'll add capacity action: temporary +2 nodes for rerank for 6 hours nightly while we verify. Mark as P0 if the customer impact score > 7.
eng-oncall-bot: Reminder: link REDW-9123/9124 back to postmortem thread: https://redwood.slack/postmortems/3309876543. Auto-check scheduled in 24h.
Rosa: Quick note for the investigation checklist I'm drafting:
```
- collect heap dumps at T+0, T+30m, T+2h
- record GC pause durations and frequencies
- compare kernel module versions across nodes
- run stress repro with seq_len=512 and batch=8 for 6h
```
Daniel: Will add mitigation checklist into REDW-9123 and include a smoke canary that runs every hour for 2h after deploy.
Priya: I'm assigning the PM to prioritize these in next sprint planning. Also setting a weekly remediation sync on Thursdays 10am for updates until closure.
Tomas: If infra changes are needed, tag REDW-INFRA and we'll fast-track reviews.
Rosa: Will include acceptance criteria: reproduce memory rise, identify leak or pattern, proposed fix, and non-regression on 99p latency.
Priya: Great. Please drop the PRs and test links in the JIRA comments and ping me. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
Daniel: Thanks team. I'll post a short runbook for oncall to follow during the mitigation window.
eng-oncall-bot: Action: oncall escalation set to 'silent' for noisy alerts during the canary window per request.
